Join an academic community who is “measured not by whom it excludes, but by whom it includes and how they succeed.” Design your ASU experience with excellent academics and endless opportunities Quality degreesASU offers highly ranked undergraduate and graduate degree programs taught by some of the best minds in academia to prepare you for an outstanding career. Search degrees A customized experienceYou’ll have almost endless opportunities to personalize your course of study. Work toward a master’s degree while earning your bachelor’s, double major or add a minor or certificate.Explore options The best location for youASU offers four campuses in metro Phoenix, and locations in downtown Los Angeles, Washington, D.C., and more. And you can earn a degree from anywhere through ASU Online. Find your fit Admission information for: Cost and financial aid As one of the top “best buy” public universities in the nation, ASU is committed to offering you a top-quality education that provides the most value for your investment and prepares you for a lifetime of success. Sign up to receive communications about degree programs, scholarships, opportunities, events and admission details. Find out more about admission requirements and start your application for admission today. Outstanding students ASU students begin making a positive impact while they are still earning their degree, and they graduate prepared to take an active role in the world as leaders, innovators and collaborators. Students here come from a wide range of backgrounds and worldviews, enabling them to learn from each other's varied perspectives. Sun Devils earn some of the top academic awards, including the Fulbright, Rhodes, Churchill and Gates Cambridge Scholarships, as well as ASU merit scholarships. 3.97 GPA The first-year, on-campus cohort from Arizona is one of the most academically prepared in ASU history with a 3.97 average weighted GPA, a university record. 1 in 3 One in three students enrolled at ASU are first-generation college students. 165+ countries165+ countries and all 50 states represented at ASU. Prepare for career success ASU ranks No. 2 in the U.S. for graduate employability and No. 5 in the U.S. for best internship programs among public universities. That’s because it’s a career ecosystem, where almost every experience sets you up for a successful future. Plus you’ll have access to the best internships and top industry partnerships — opportunities you can’t get in smaller cities — and you’ll graduate prepared for the job you want in a career that you love. If you’re starting to picture yourself at ASU, we’re here to help you with the next step. Take an Experience ASU tour, where one of our students will show you around and answer all your questions.
